# @devalok/shilp-sutra-brand

> Logo components and brand assets for Devalok and Karm.
> Provides React components, favicon helpers, and raw asset imports.
> Version: 0.6.0

## Install & Import

pnpm add @devalok/shilp-sutra-brand

// Logo components:
import { DevalokLogo, KarmLogo } from '@devalok/shilp-sutra-brand'

// Per-brand imports:
import { DevalokLogo, generateDevalokFavicon } from '@devalok/shilp-sutra-brand/devalok'
import { KarmLogo, generateKarmFavicon } from '@devalok/shilp-sutra-brand/karm'

// Raw asset files:
import monogram from '@devalok/shilp-sutra-brand/assets/devalok/logos/monogram-brand-512.png'

## Components

### DevalokLogo
- type: 'monogram' | 'monogram-wordmark' | 'monogram-shell' | 'monogram-shell-wordmark' | 'monogram-coin-wordmark' | 'wordmark' | 'dass' | 'shloka' | 'chakra'
- color: 'brand' | 'black' | 'white' | 'auto' (auto = dark mode aware via .dark class)
- size: 'xs' (24px) | 'sm' (32px) | 'md' (40px) | 'lg' (56px) | 'xl' (80px)
- simplifyBelow: number (auto-simplify to monogram below this width, default 32)
- aria-label, aria-hidden, role, className

### DevalokLogo.Link
- Compound anchor wrapper: <DevalokLogo.Link href="/"><DevalokLogo type="monogram" /></DevalokLogo.Link>
- Extends React.AnchorHTMLAttributes

### KarmLogo
- type: 'icon' | 'wordmark' | 'wordmark-icon'
- color: 'brand' | 'black' | 'white' | 'auto'
- size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' (same px mapping as DevalokLogo)
- Same accessibility props as DevalokLogo

### KarmLogo.Link
- Same pattern as DevalokLogo.Link

## Favicon Helpers

### generateDevalokFavicon()
Returns Next.js metadata-compatible icon config (no arguments).
Returns: { icon: [ico, svg], apple: [apple-touch-icon.png] }

Usage in Next.js layout.tsx:
  import { generateDevalokFavicon } from '@devalok/shilp-sutra-brand/devalok'
  export const metadata = { icons: generateDevalokFavicon() }

### generateKarmFavicon()
Same pattern (no arguments). Returns: { icon: [ico], apple: [apple-touch-icon.png], manifest }
  import { generateKarmFavicon } from '@devalok/shilp-sutra-brand/karm'
  export const metadata = { icons: generateKarmFavicon() }

### getDevalokFaviconPath(options?)
Returns a single favicon file path string.
  options: { format?: 'ico' | 'svg' | 'png', name?: 'apple-touch-icon' | 'icon-192' | 'icon-512' }
  Default format: 'svg'. name is only used when format is 'png'.

### getKarmFaviconPath(options?)
Returns a single favicon file path string.
  options: { format?: 'ico' | 'png', name?: 'apple-touch-icon' | 'icon-192' | 'icon-512' }
  Default format: 'ico'. No SVG available for Karm.

## Raw Asset Paths

Assets available via wildcard import: @devalok/shilp-sutra-brand/assets/*

Devalok logos (PNG/WebP at 512/1024 grid, 3 colors each):
  assets/devalok/logos/{type}-{color}-{size}.{png,webp}
  Types: monogram, monogram-wordmark, monogram-shell, monogram-shell-wordmark, monogram-coin-wordmark, shloka
  Colors: brand, black, white
  Sizes: 512, 1024 (longest edge, aspect ratio preserved)

Devalok favicons (5 files):
  assets/devalok/favicons/favicon.ico
  assets/devalok/favicons/favicon.svg
  assets/devalok/favicons/apple-touch-icon.png
  assets/devalok/favicons/icon-192.png
  assets/devalok/favicons/icon-512.png

Karm favicons (4 files, no SVG):
  assets/karm/favicons/favicon.ico
  assets/karm/favicons/apple-touch-icon.png
  assets/karm/favicons/icon-192.png
  assets/karm/favicons/icon-512.png

## Key Notes

- color="auto" uses MutationObserver on .dark class for dark mode switching
- Raster-complex logos (monogram, monogram-wordmark, monogram-shell, monogram-shell-wordmark, monogram-coin-wordmark, shloka) render as <img> from PNG/WebP at 512/1024 grid; no SVG exports for these types
- Karm logos are all inline SVG (no PNG assets)
- Brand colors: brand=#D33163, brandDark=#B8284F
